about.title: About me
about.bio1: I'm a self-taught Full-Stack Developer passionate about building complete, functional, and attractive web applications. I specialize in creating solid solutions, covering everything from backend logic and databases (Python, Django) to dynamic and modern user interfaces on the frontend (React, JavaScript).
about.bio2: My ability to master both areas allows me to have a holistic view of every project, focusing on both UX/UI and architecture and scalability. I also have extensive experience in data optimization, Web Scraping, and solving complex technical requirements.
